shared.tagline.en: Know the wait before you walk in.
shared.tagline.text: San lokacin jira kafin ka shiga.

shared.footer.copyright.en: © 2026 PickupRadar. Independent and not affiliated with Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat.
shared.footer.copyright.text: © 2026 PickupRadar. Mai zaman kansa ne, ba shi da alaƙa da Uber Eats, Deliveroo ko Just Eat.

shared.scale.estimate.en: No recent reports? PickupRadar may show {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}:
shared.scale.estimate.text: Babu sabon rahoto? PickupRadar na iya nuna {likelyFast} ko {likelySlow}:

home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): lokacin jiran ɗauka ga direbobi a Birtaniya

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Duba tsawon lokacin da direbobi ke jira a gidajen abinci da shaguna kafin ka shiga. Ga direbobin Uber Eats, Deliveroo da Just Eat a Birtaniya. Babu rajista.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. San lokacin jira kafin ka shiga.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: Kana kai kaya ga Uber Eats, Deliveroo ko Just Eat? Duba sabon lokacin jira a wuraren ɗauka na gidajen abinci da shaguna. Guji jira mai tsawo. Danna {reportWait} ka samu {radarPoints}. Babu rajista.

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.
home.hero.cities.text: Yanzu a Milton Keynes. Na gaba London.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: Manhajojin iPhone da Android na zuwa nan ba da jimawa ba.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: Misalin allon gida na PickupRadar tare da shafin {nearby} a buɗe. Wuraren ɗauka suna da launi bisa lokacin jira

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Allon misali: lokacin jira na misali ne, ba rahoton direba kai tsaye ba

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Allon misali. Wannan lokacin jira ne na misali, ba rahoto kai tsaye ba. {live} da bayanan gaskiya.

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Yi amfani da {nearby} don nemo wuraren ɗauka kusa da kai idan wurin yana kunne. Yi amfani da {fast} da {slow} don duba lokutan jira da kiyasai.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Gwada suna, yanki ko lambar gidan waya, kamar KFC ko Bletchley.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} Allon {reportWait} zai buɗe. Zaɓi lokacin jira. Babu abin da ake aikawa.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in
home.signals.title.text: Abin da kake gani kafin ka shiga

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: Kana ganin alamun iri ɗaya a cikin manhaja. Direbobi ne ke bayar da rahotonsu, ba manhajar isarwa ba.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Direbobi suna zaɓar lokacin jira. Kana ganin lokacin jira na yanzu da adadin direbobin da suka ba da rahoto a cikin awanni 2 da suka wuce.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: Ana nuna shi ne kawai idan babu sabon rahoto. Kiyasi ne, ba rahoto kai tsaye ba.

home.signals.closed.pill.text: An bayar da rahoton rufe kwanan nan

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Direbobi suna danna {reportProblem} don bayar da rahoton wannan. Kana ganin rahoton kafin ka tafi can.

home.signals.missing.title.text: Wuri na ɗauka da ya ɓace ko kuskure

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Matakai uku masu sauƙi. Bayar da rahoto yana ɗaukar daƙiƙu kaɗan.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Babu kalmar sirri. Manhaja tana ba ka bayanin Radar kai tsaye. Ba ka buƙatar yin rajista.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Nemi wuri na ɗauka. Duba lokacin jira na yanzu, ko {likelyFast} ko {likelySlow} idan babu sabon rahoto.

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Bayan ka ɗauki oda, danna {reportWait}. Yana ɗaukar daƙiƙu kaɗan. Rahotonka yana taimaka wa sauran direbobi, kuma kana samun {radarPoints}.

home.points.note.text: {soon} Ba za ka iya amfani da {radarPoints} ba tukuna.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Wuri na ɗauka da ya cancanci kusa da kai, babu sabon lokacin jira, kuma babu {likelyFast} ko {likelySlow}. Kana samun 15 RP don wannan rahoto, ba 10 ba.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Waɗannan garuruwan Birtaniya ne a cikin manhaja. Ba ka ganin garinka? Nemi shi a cikin manhaja. Ko danna {notify} a garin da yake {comingSoon}. Za mu aika imel idan ya fara aiki.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app
home.trust.title.text: Ba wani ɓangare na manhajar isarwa ba

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: PickupRadar mai zaman kansa ne. Ba wani ɓangare na Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat ko wata manhajar isarwa ba. Ba ya taɓa amfani da asusunka a can.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} Ba ma taɓa neman sunan mai amfani ko kalmar sirri ta Uber Eats, Deliveroo ko Just Eat.

home.trust.detailsLead.text: Babu bayanan abokin ciniki ko oda.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Babu suna, adireshin ko lambar oda.

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: A'a. Manhaja tana ba ka bayanin Radar kai tsaye. Kana iya bayar da rahoton lokacin jira nan take. Don kare {radarPoints}, ƙara imel daga baya. Babu kalmar sirri. Manhaja tana aika lambar lamba 6 ta imel.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: Manhajojin iPhone da Android na zuwa nan ba da jimawa ba. A yanzu, {preview} yana nuna wuraren ɗauka na gaskiya da lokacin jira a Milton Keynes.

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Babu bin diddigi a bayan fage. Manhaja tana amfani da wurinka yayin da kake amfani da ita, don nuna wuraren ɗauka kusa da kai da duba cewa kana wurin ɗauka yayin bayar da rahoto. Shafin yana neman wuri ne kawai idan ka zaɓi amfani da shi. Karanta {privacy} don ƙarin bayani.

app.meta.title.text: Duban kai tsaye na manhaja — PickupRadar

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Gwada manhajar PickupRadar da bayanan gaskiya na Milton Keynes. Duba kewaye, nemi wuri na ɗauka ka duba allon rahoto.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Wannan PickupRadar ne da bayanan gaskiya na Milton Keynes. Duba kewaye. Nemi wuri na ɗauka ka buɗe shi. Babu abin da ka danna a nan da ake aikawa. Kana iya bayar da rahoto a manhajar waya kawai.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: Cikakken dubawa na manhajar PickupRadar da bayanan gaskiya na Milton Keynes

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: Taimakon PickupRadar: tuntuɓi taimako, bayar da rahoton matsalar wuri na ɗauka, kuma nemo amsoshi game da bayanin Radar, {radarPoints} da share asusu.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: Kana buƙatar taimako? Aika imel game da manhaja, wuri na ɗauka, {radarPoints} ko sirrinka.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Aika imel don taimako, ra'ayi, matsalar wuri na ɗauka ko tambayar sirri:

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Don wasiƙa kawai. Imel ita ce hanya mafi sauri ta tuntuɓar mu.

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:
support.include.body.text: Idan kana bayar da rahoton matsala, gaya mana:

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: Yanki ko lambar gidan waya, idan ka sani

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Nau'in wayarka, idan matsala a cikin manhaja ce

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: Manhaja tana ba ka bayanin Radar kai tsaye. Ba ka buƙatar shiga don amfani da PickupRadar ko samun {radarPoints}. Ƙara imel zaɓi ne. Yana kare {radarPoints} idan ka canza ko sake saita waya. Babu kalmar sirri. Manhaja tana aika lambar lamba 6 ta imel.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: Kana samun {radarPoints} don rahoton jira mai inganci ({waitRp}, ko {neededRp} idan an rubuta {reportNeeded}), kari na rahoto na farko ({firstRp}) da wuri na ɗauka da muka amince da shi ({approvedRp}). Kana iya gayyatar direba daga {profile}. Ku duka kuna buƙatar asusun Radar mai kariya (ƙara imel). Abokinka yana shigar da lambarka kafin rahoton jira na farko mai inganci. Idan abokinka ya yi rahotannin jira 3 masu inganci, aƙalla a ranaku 2 daban-daban (lokacin UTC), a wuraren ɗauka 2 daban-daban, kowane ɗaya yana samun {referralRp}. {rewards} Ba za ka iya amfani da {radarPoints} ba tukuna.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: {profile} yana da {messages}: sanarwa, faɗakarwa da saƙonni na sirri ga garinka ko bayanin Radar ɗinka. Tsoffin saƙonni ko waɗanda aka cire ƙila ba za su sake bayyana ba.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: Share asusu a cikin manhaja: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Ko aika imel zuwa {email}. Idan ba ka ƙara imel ba, manhaja tana nuna {deleteProfile}. Duba shafin {page} don matakan.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Babu wuri na ɗauka? Danna {suggest} a cikin manhaja. Akwai kuskure? Danna {reportProblem}. Ko aika imel, za mu duba.

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: PickupRadar baya haɗuwa da asusunka na Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat ko wata manhajar isarwa. Ba ma taɓa neman shiga, kalmar sirri, bayanan asusu, bayanan abokin ciniki ko bayanan oda. Direbobi suna raba rahotannin ɗauka kawai, kamar lokacin jira da matsalar wuri na ɗauka.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.
support.closer.title.text: Gwada PickupRadar kafin manhaja ta fito.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Duban kai tsaye yana nuna wuraren ɗauka na gaskiya da lokacin jira a Milton Keynes. Bayar da rahoto da {radarPoints} a cikin manhajar waya kawai suke.

notfound.meta.title.text: Ba a sami shafi ba — PickupRadar

notfound.meta.description.en: That page is not on the PickupRadar website.
notfound.meta.description.text: Wannan shafi baya kan shafin PickupRadar.

notfound.title.en: This page is off the radar.

notfound.body.en: That address isn't on the PickupRadar website. These pages are:
notfound.body.text: Wannan adireshin baya kan shafin PickupRadar. Waɗannan shafuka suna nan:

privacy.notice.en: The summary and section headings are translated. The full privacy policy is in English, which is the official version.
privacy.notice.text: An fassara taƙaitawa da kanun sassan. Cikakkiyar manufar sirri tana cikin Turanci, kuma sigar Turanci ita ce sigar hukuma.

privacy.h.collect.en: Information we collect and how we use it
privacy.h.collect.text: Bayanan da muke tattarawa da yadda muke amfani da su

privacy.h.retention.text: Tsawon lokacin da muke ajiye bayanai

privacy.sum.what.en: PickupRadar helps delivery drivers see and report pickup wait times and venue problems.
privacy.sum.what.text: PickupRadar tana taimaka wa direbobin isar da kaya su gani kuma su ba da rahoton lokacin jira wajen karɓar oda da matsalolin wurare.

privacy.sum.account.en: You can browse without creating an account. The app creates an anonymous Radar profile for your phone, and an email account is optional.
privacy.sum.account.text: Za ka iya bincike ba tare da asusu ba. Manhajar tana ƙirƙirar bayanin Radar mara suna don wayarka, kuma asusun imel na zaɓi ne.

privacy.sum.location.en: If you allow location, the app uses it while you are using it: to sort nearby pickup points, detect your city and check that you are at a venue when you submit a live report. We do not save your location with your reports.
privacy.sum.location.text: Idan ka ba da izinin wuri, manhajar tana amfani da shi ne kawai lokacin da kake amfani da ita: don jera wuraren karɓa na kusa, gano garinka, da tabbatar da cewa kana wurin lokacin da kake aika rahoto kai tsaye. Ba ma ajiye wurinka tare da rahotanninka.

privacy.sum.saved.en: Your saved pickup points stay on your phone.
privacy.sum.saved.text: Wuraren karɓa da ka ajiye suna zama a wayarka.

privacy.sum.noSale.en: We do not sell your personal information and the app contains no advertising or analytics trackers.
privacy.sum.noSale.text: Ba ma sayar da bayananka na sirri, kuma manhajar ba ta da masu bin diddigin talla ko nazari.

privacy.sum.delete.en: You can delete your Radar profile or account in the app, or ask us by email. See {link}.
privacy.sum.delete.text: Za ka iya goge bayanin Radar ko asusunka a cikin manhajar, ko ka aiko mana da imel. Duba {link}.

delete.meta.title.en: Delete your account or data — PickupRadar

delete.meta.description.en: How to delete your PickupRadar account, Radar profile and associated data, including without the app.
delete.meta.description.text: Yadda ake goge asusun PickupRadar, bayanin Radar da bayanan da suka danganci su, ko da babu manhajar.

delete.lead.en: This page explains how to delete your PickupRadar account, your Radar profile and the data linked to them, including if you no longer have the app. PickupRadar is developed by Hamza Khan.
delete.lead.text: Wannan shafin yana bayyana yadda ake goge asusunka na PickupRadar, bayanin Radar naka da bayanan da ke da alaƙa da su, ko da ba ka da manhajar kuma. Hamza Khan ne ya ƙirƙiri PickupRadar.

delete.app.step2.en: Tap {profile} at the bottom of the Home screen.

delete.app.step3.en: Scroll down and tap {deleteAccount} if you protected your RadarPoints with your email, or {deleteProfile} if you did not.
delete.app.step3.text: Gungura ƙasa ka taɓa {deleteAccount} idan ka kare RadarPoints naka da imel, ko {deleteProfile} idan ba haka ba.

delete.app.after.en: Deletion starts straight away. Afterwards, the app starts a new anonymous Radar profile on your phone.
delete.app.after.text: Gogewa tana farawa nan take. Bayan haka manhajar tana fara sabon bayanin Radar mara suna a wayarka.

delete.email.title.en: Ask us to delete your email account
delete.email.title.text: Ka nemi mu goge asusunka na imel

delete.email.intro.en: If you protected your RadarPoints with your email address and cannot use the app:
delete.email.intro.text: Idan ka kare RadarPoints naka da adireshin imel kuma ba za ka iya amfani da manhajar ba:

delete.email.from.en: from the email address on your PickupRadar account
delete.email.from.text: daga adireshin imel na asusunka na PickupRadar

delete.email.step2.en: We will reply to that address to confirm the request before deleting anything.
delete.email.step2.text: Za mu amsa zuwa wannan adireshin don tabbatar da buƙatar kafin mu goge komai.

delete.email.other.en: If you write from a different address, we will need to confirm that you control the account’s email address. We will never ask for a password or for a sign-in code. Do not send us your code.
delete.email.other.text: Idan ka rubuto daga wani adireshi, za mu buƙaci tabbatar da cewa kai ne ke sarrafa adireshin imel na asusun. Ba za mu taɓa neman kalmar sirri ko lambar shiga ba. Kada ka aiko mana da lambarka.

delete.anon.p1.en: If you never added an email address, your Radar profile is linked only to a random ID stored in the app on your phone. The easiest way to delete it is in the app, using the steps above.
delete.anon.p1.text: Idan ba ka taɓa ƙara adireshin imel ba, bayanin Radar naka yana da alaƙa ne kawai da ID na bazuwar da aka ajiye a cikin manhajar wayarka. Hanya mafi sauƙi ta goge shi ita ce a cikin manhajar, da matakan da ke sama.

delete.anon.p2.en: Deleting the app removes that ID from your phone, but it does {not} delete the records on our servers.
delete.anon.p2.text: Goge manhajar yana cire wannan ID daga wayarka, amma {not} bayanan da ke kan sabobinmu.

delete.anon.p3.en: Ownership of an anonymous profile can only be proven from the phone it was created on, using the random ID and secret code stored in the app. Details such as a Radar name, a city or the dates you used the app can’t prove that a profile is yours, because other people could know them. So if you no longer have the app, we may not be able to delete an anonymous profile. You can still email {email} and we will explain what we can do.
delete.anon.p3.text: Ana iya tabbatar da mallakar bayanin mara suna ne kawai daga wayar da aka ƙirƙira shi a kanta, ta amfani da ID na bazuwar da lambar sirri da aka ajiye a cikin manhajar. Bayanai kamar sunan Radar, gari ko ranakun da ka yi amfani da manhajar ba sa tabbatar da cewa bayanin naka ne, domin wasu ma suna iya sanin su. Saboda haka, idan ba ka da manhajar kuma, ƙila ba za mu iya goge bayanin mara suna ba. Duk da haka za ka iya aika imel zuwa {email} kuma za mu bayyana abin da za mu iya yi.

delete.alerts.title.text: Imel ɗin sanarwar ƙaddamarwa a birane

delete.alerts.body.en: You can withdraw a launch alert in the app, or email us from the address you signed up with and we will delete the sign-ups for that address. Launch-alert emails are also deleted automatically, as explained in our {privacy}.
delete.alerts.body.text: Za ka iya janye sanarwar ƙaddamarwa a cikin manhajar, ko ka aiko mana da imel daga adireshin da ka yi rajista da shi kuma za mu goge rajistar wannan adireshin. Ana kuma goge imel ɗin sanarwar ƙaddamarwa ta atomatik, kamar yadda {privacy} ɗinmu ta bayyana.

delete.deleted.profile.en: Your Radar profile, Radar name, RadarPoints and contribution history
delete.deleted.profile.text: Bayanin Radar naka, sunan Radar, RadarPoints da tarihin gudummawa

delete.deleted.email.en: Your email sign-in, if you had an email account
delete.deleted.email.text: Shigarka ta imel, idan kana da asusun imel

delete.deleted.links.en: The links between your phone’s device ID and your profile
delete.deleted.links.text: Alaƙa tsakanin ID na na'urar wayarka da bayaninka

delete.deleted.referrals.en: Your referral codes, and your read or dismissed status for in-app messages
delete.deleted.referrals.text: Lambobin gayyatarka, da matsayin karantawa ko rufewa na saƙonnin manhajar

delete.deleted.alerts.en: City launch alert sign-ups linked to your profile or phone
delete.deleted.alerts.text: Rajistar sanarwar ƙaddamarwa da ke da alaƙa da bayaninka ko wayarka

delete.deleted.notes.en: Notes on the problem reports, status reports and venue suggestions linked to your profile
delete.deleted.notes.text: Bayanin kula a kan rahotannin matsala, rahotannin matsayi da shawarwarin wurare da ke da alaƙa da bayaninka

delete.kept.title.text: Abin da za a iya ajiyewa

delete.kept.reports.en: {lead}, such as wait times, venue status reports and tags, and venue suggestions: the device ID on the records linked to your profile is replaced with a random value, so they are no longer connected to your profile in our database. They still contain details such as the venue and time, so they are de-identified rather than fully anonymous. They may be kept so they can still help other drivers.
delete.kept.reports.text: {lead}, kamar lokutan jira, rahotannin matsayi da alamomin wurare, da shawarwarin wurare: ana maye gurbin ID na na'ura a cikin bayanan da ke da alaƙa da bayaninka da ƙima ta bazuwar, don haka a cikin ma'ajiyar bayananmu ba su da alaƙa da bayaninka kuma. Har yanzu suna ɗauke da bayanai kamar wuri da lokaci, don haka an cire bayanin tantancewa, amma ba su zama marasa suna gaba ɗaya ba. Ana iya ajiye su don su ci gaba da taimaka wa sauran direbobi.

delete.kept.referrals.en: {lead} that involved you, without your profile.
delete.kept.referrals.text: {lead} da ka shiga, ba tare da bayaninka ba.

delete.kept.receipt.en: {lead} for email accounts (an internal account reference, the device ID, a one-way scrambled copy of the phone’s secret code and dates), so the deletion can be completed safely and shown to have happened.
delete.kept.receipt.text: {lead} don asusun imel (wani lambar asusu ta ciki, ID na na'ura, kwafin lambar sirrin wayar da aka ɓoye ta hanya ɗaya, da ranaku), don a kammala gogewar cikin aminci kuma a nuna cewa ta faru.

delete.kept.backups.en: {lead}: our database provider keeps daily backups for 7 days, so deleted information can stay in a backup for up to 7 days.
delete.kept.backups.text: {lead}: mai samar da ma'ajiyar bayananmu yana ajiye kwafin ajiya na kullum na kwanaki 7, don haka bayanan da aka goge za su iya zama a cikin kwafin ajiya har zuwa kwanaki 7.

delete.kept.support.en: {lead} about your request, for as long as we need them to deal with it.
delete.kept.support.text: {lead} game da buƙatarka, muddin ana buƙata don kula da ita.

delete.kept.more.en: See our {privacy} for full details of how long we keep information and your other rights.
delete.kept.more.text: Don cikakken bayani kan tsawon lokacin da muke ajiye bayanai da sauran haƙƙoƙinka, duba {privacy} ɗinmu.
